resolution: Inspection of Windows Time settings showed 'Adjust for daylight saving time automatically' was toggled OFF by an erroneous registry tweak. Windows had failed to advance from Standard Time to Daylight Saving Time (EDT). The technician updated the registry key 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation' setting 'DynamicDaylightTimeDisabled' to 0, restarted the Windows Time service ('net stop w32time && net start w32time'), and triggered 'w32tm /resync'. Outlook refreshed calendar appointments to the correct local time slots.

short_description: Windows Update error 0x80070002 from corrupted SoftwareDistribution store
description: Over 40 laptops in Building D failed their monthly security compliance check because Windows Update consistently failed with error code 0x80070002.
resolution: Error 0x80070002 indicates ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND, caused by an interrupted download corrupting the local update cache. The technician deployed an automated remediation script that stopped Windows Update and BITS services, renamed 'C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution' to 'SoftwareDistribution.old', renamed 'catroot2' to 'catroot2.old', and restarted the services. Windows Update re-downloaded pristine update packages and successfully installed the latest security patches.

short_description: Bluetooth peripheral disconnect loop on macOS Sonoma from corrupt plist
description: Creative director's Apple Magic Keyboard and Magic Trackpad repeatedly disconnected and reconnected every 10 seconds, making work impossible.
resolution: Bluetooth diagnostic packet trace showed the Bluetooth daemon (bluetoothd) crashing whenever establishing an encrypted L2CAP link. The technician removed corrupted property lists via Terminal ('sudo rm /Library/Preferences/com.apple.Bluetooth.plist' and 'rm ~/Library/Preferences/ByHost/com.apple.Bluetooth.*'), reset the Bluetooth module via 'sudo pkill bluetoothd', and power-cycled the Mac. Peripherals paired cleanly and sustained uninterrupted connectivity.

short_description: Windows Fast Startup causing network adapter failure on morning power-on
description: Call center agents reported that their wired Ethernet connection failed with 'No internet' every morning when turning on PCs, requiring a manual reboot to fix.
resolution: Event Viewer showed Intel Ethernet Connection I219-LM failing initialization from hibernate state. Windows Fast Startup saves kernel state to hiberfil.sys during shutdown, but the network driver was failing DMA re-initialization upon resume. The technician disabled Fast Startup globally via GPO registry key 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power' setting 'HiberbootEnabled' to 0. Workstations performed clean cold boots each morning with 100% network adapter reliability.

short_description: Logitech conference webcam USB descriptor failure freezing Zoom Rooms
description: Main executive conference room Zoom Rooms console displayed 'No camera detected', preventing video calls during high-priority board meetings.
resolution: Diagnostics on the Zoom Rooms PC showed USB controller error code 43 ('A request for the USB device descriptor failed') for the Logitech MeetUp camera. The active USB 3.0 optical extension cable had suffered a power drop. The technician power-cycled the camera unit, replaced the damaged extension cable with a powered USB 3.2 Gen 2 cable, and updated the Logitech MeetUp firmware to v1.0.28 using Logitech Sync. The camera initialized immediately and video feeds restored.

short_description: Cryptographic Services cryptsvc high disk IO scanning corrupt catalog
description: Laptops running Windows 10 exhibited severe disk thrashing with 'Cryptographic Services' consuming 80MB/s disk write bandwidth for hours.
resolution: Performance logs showed 'cryptsvc' in an endless loop validating corrupted security catalog files in 'C:\Windows\System32\catroot2'. The technician executed an elevated script to stop Cryptographic Services ('net stop cryptsvc'), renamed the catroot2 folder to 'catroot2.old', and restarted the service. Windows automatically generated a healthy, uncorrupted catalog database. Disk write activity ceased immediately, restoring normal system responsiveness.

short_description: Apple Silicon Rosetta 2 translation error halting legacy analytics tools
description: Data scientists on new Apple M3 MacBook Pros were unable to launch x86-64 legacy Python scientific libraries, receiving 'Bad CPU type in executable'.
resolution: The error indicated that Rosetta 2 binary translation was not installed on the newly imaged Apple Silicon macOS environment. The technician executed 'softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license' via remote Terminal command through Jamf Pro. Rosetta 2 binaries installed and registered with the Darwin kernel. The data science team executed their legacy x86-64 binaries and analytics workflows without issue.

short_description: Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime corruption crashing internal CRM desktop app
description: Customer support representatives were unable to launch the internal desktop CRM tool; the app crashed immediately upon launch with error code 0x80004005.
resolution: Application crash logs indicated that the host application failed to load the embedded Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime DLL due to corrupted file hashes in 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\EdgeWebView'. The technician downloaded the official Microsoft Evergreen WebView2 standalone installer, executed an administrative silent repair install ('MicrosoftEdgeWebView2RuntimeInstallerX64.exe /silent /install'), and cleared the app local cache folder. The CRM desktop app launched smoothly.

short_description: Windows Volume Shadow Copy VSS error 0x80042306 failing endpoint backup
description: Automated enterprise endpoint backup agent Veeam failed nightly backups across 30 finance laptops with error 'VSS snapshot creation failed'.
resolution: Executing 'vssadmin list writers' showed the 'System Writer' and 'WMI Writer' in state '[9] Failed' with last error 'Timed out'. Third-party disk encryption software had locked shadow storage allocation. The technician increased shadow storage space to 15% of disk capacity via 'vssadmin resize shadowstorage /for=C: /on=C: /maxsize=15%', re-registered VSS DLLs in System32, and restarted the Volume Shadow Copy service. Subsequent backup snapshot completed in 4 minutes.

short_description: DisplayPort Multi-Stream Transport MST daisy chain secondary monitor failure
description: Graphic designers using daisy-chained Dell monitors via DisplayPort 1.4 found the second monitor stuck in mirrored 640x480 resolution instead of extended 2560x1440.
resolution: Hardware review showed that DisplayPort MST (Multi-Stream Transport) was toggled to 'Disabled' in the primary monitor's on-screen display (OSD) menu following a factory reset. Without MST enabled on the primary monitor, DisplayPort 1.4 treats downstream connections as legacy single-stream cloned displays. The technician enabled MST in the primary monitor's OSD settings and updated the Intel Iris Xe graphics driver. Both monitors extended properly at full 2560x1440 resolution at 60Hz.

short_description: Windows Event Log service crash loop stalling corporate logon scripts
description: Workstations across the human resources department hung on 'Please wait for User Profile Service' for 15 minutes before logging in, with security auditing disabled.
resolution: System inspection showed the Windows Event Log service ('eventlog') crashing on startup because the Security event log file 'C:\Windows\System32\winevt\Logs\Security.evtx' was corrupted. Group Policy security auditing blocked logon progression while auditing was unavailable. The technician booted into WinRE command prompt, renamed 'Security.evtx' to 'Security.old', restarted the machine, and verified eventlog recreated a pristine 20MB log file. Workstation logons completed in 8 seconds.

short_description: Exchange Online mailbox ProhibitSendQuota reached halting outbound email
description: Chief Legal Officer was unable to send critical contracts, receiving Non-Delivery Report (NDR) '554 5.2.2 mailbox full; StoreDriver.StorageProvider.QuotaExceededException'.
resolution: Diagnostics via Exchange Online PowerShell ('Get-MailboxStatistics cl_officer@company.com') showed total item size at 101.4GB, exceeding the E5 license 100GB primary mailbox limit. The technician enabled auto-expanding archive via 'Enable-Mailbox cl_officer@company.com -AutoExpandingArchive', applied an aggressive 30-day archive retention tag, and forced immediate mailbox ingestion using 'Start-ManagedFolderAssistant -Identity cl_officer@company.com'. Over 35GB of older attachments moved to the online archive within 45 minutes, restoring outbound email sending.

short_description: DMARC p=reject policy failure causing Gmail and Yahoo quarantine
description: Customer support notification emails to external customers using @gmail.com and @yahoo.com were bouncing or landing in spam folders.
resolution: Header analysis of rejected messages showed 'dmarc=fail (p=reject) action=quarantine' because a newly deployed Zendesk ticketing instance was sending mail without SPF alignment or valid DKIM signatures. The technician updated the corporate public DNS SPF TXT record to include 'include:mail.zendesk.com', generated a 2048-bit DKIM key pair in Zendesk Admin, published the corresponding CNAME records in public Route 53 DNS, and verified alignment with MXToolbox. Inbound delivery to Gmail and Yahoo succeeded with 'dmarc=pass'.

short_description: Microsoft Teams desktop client white-screen freezing on Electron cache corruption
description: Dozens of customer success representatives were unable to join customer check-in calls; the Teams desktop app launched to a blank white screen and froze.
resolution: Crash telemetry indicated that the Teams WebView2/Electron IndexedDB cache had become corrupted during an ungraceful Windows shutdown. The technician closed all Teams background processes ('taskkill /F /IM ms-teams.exe'), navigated to '%LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\MSTeams_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalCache\Microsoft\MSTeams', and cleared the corrupted cache folders ('EBWebView' and 'IndexedDB'). Upon relaunching, Teams initialized a fresh local profile, prompted for seamless SSO login, and loaded chats and calendars within 10 seconds.

short_description: OneDrive Sync client stuck in Processing Changes loop from hidden lock files
description: Finance analysts reported that OneDrive desktop sync client remained perpetually in 'Processing changes' state, consuming 40% CPU and failing to sync monthly budget sheets.
resolution: Diagnostics on the OneDrive sync engine showed two hidden Excel temporary lock files ('~$Budget_2024.xlsx') orphaned after an Excel crash with invalid Unicode timestamps. The sync engine hung attempting to resolve file lock conflicts. The technician killed OneDrive ('taskkill /F /IM onedrive.exe'), deleted the zero-byte temporary files using PowerShell ('Get-ChildItem -Path $env:OneDrive -Hidden -Filter ~* | Remove-Item -Force'), and executed 'onedrive.exe /reset'. OneDrive restarted, re-indexed the library, and reached 'Up to date' status within 8 minutes.

short_description: Outlook desktop search returning no results due to corrupted OST cache
description: Senior executives could not search for past emails or attachments in Outlook 365, with search queries returning 'No results found' or 'Something went wrong'.
resolution: Investigation revealed that the local Outlook Offline Storage Table file (outlook.ost) had suffered sector corruption, preventing Windows Search service from indexing messages. The technician closed Outlook, navigated to '%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Outlook', renamed the corrupted file to 'outlook.ost.old', and relaunched Outlook. Outlook automatically provisioned a fresh OST file from Exchange Online cloud mailboxes and rebuilt the local cache. Search queries returned complete, accurate results immediately.

short_description: Shared mailbox auto-mapping failure in Outlook from security group assignment
description: New customer support team members were unable to see the shared 'support@company.com' mailbox in Outlook desktop, despite having been granted Full Access permissions.
resolution: Exchange Online architecture limitation: Auto-mapping only functions when Full Access permissions are assigned directly to individual user accounts, not when inherited via nested security groups. The technician connected to Exchange Online PowerShell and executed 'Add-MailboxPermission -Identity support@company.com -User new_hire@company.com -AccessRights FullAccess -AutoMapping $true'. Within 15 minutes, Autodiscover pushed the shared mailbox profile, and it appeared automatically in Outlook's folder tree.

short_description: SharePoint Online sync exceeding 300,000 item limit crashing OneDrive client
description: Engineering team members syncing the massive 'All Documents' SharePoint library experienced severe OneDrive client crashes with error 'OneDrive is syncing too many files'.
resolution: Microsoft documentation specifies that syncing document libraries with more than 300,000 files causes severe memory degradation and sync failure in the OneDrive client. The library contained 420,000 files. The technician stopped the global sync via OneDrive Settings > Account > Stop Sync, enabled 'Files On-Demand' globally via Intune policy, and guided the team to sync only specific active project subfolders or use 'Add shortcut to OneDrive' in SharePoint web interface. OneDrive memory usage dropped from 3.2GB to 180MB, restoring sync stability.

short_description: Exchange Hybrid Free/Busy calendar lookup failure from OAuth token expiration
description: Employees with cloud mailboxes could not view calendar free/busy availability for colleagues whose mailboxes still resided on-premises, seeing grey cross-hatching.
resolution: Running 'Test-OAuthConnectivity -Service EWS -TargetUri https://mail.corp.internal/ews/exchange.asmx' in Exchange Online PowerShell failed with error '401 Unauthorized: Token signature verification failed'. The on-premises Exchange Server hybrid OAuth trust certificate had expired. The technician ran 'New-ExchangeCertificate' on the on-premises Exchange server to generate a new 5-year auth certificate, updated the Auth Server object via 'Set-AuthServer', and uploaded the certificate to Microsoft Entra ID. Cross-premises calendar availability restored immediately.

short_description: Outbound SMTP relay connector rejecting automated invoices with error 550 5.7.60
description: Automated billing ERP system failed to send monthly customer invoices, logging error '550 5.7.60 SMTP; Client does not have permissions to send as this sender'.
resolution: Diagnostics on the Exchange Online Inbound Mail Flow Connector revealed that the ERP server sent messages with 'From: billing@company.com', but authenticated to SMTP with service account 'erp-service@company.com'. Exchange Online rejected the mismatch as unauthorized spoofing. The technician granted 'Send As' permissions on the billing mailbox to the ERP service account via 'Add-RecipientPermission -Identity billing@company.com -Trustee erp-service@company.com -AccessRights SendAs' and whitelisted the ERP static public IP on the connector. Batch invoice dispatch completed successfully.

short_description: Microsoft 365 Apps activation error 0x80070005 from stale Office identity cache
description: Users opening Word and Excel received banner notification 'Product Deactivated: We've run into a problem with your Microsoft 365 subscription', with error code 0x80070005.
resolution: Error 0x80070005 indicates access denied while updating Office shared licensing tokens. The technician ran the Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant (SaRA) command-line tool ('OLicenseCleanup.vbs') to purge stale cached licenses from 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Common\Identity\Identities' and removed cached credentials from Windows Credential Manager. Upon relaunching Word, users signed in with their Entra ID credentials, and the Microsoft 365 Enterprise E5 license activated successfully.

short_description: DKIM selector CNAME deletion causing outbound emails to fail cryptographic check
description: Marketing automated campaign emails were rejected by corporate recipient firewalls with NDR '550 5.7.26 DKIM authentication failure'.
resolution: Inspection of DNS records using 'dig CNAME selector1._domainkey.company.com' returned NXDOMAIN. A DNS zone cleanup script had inadvertently deleted the DKIM CNAME pointers to 'selector1-company-com._domainkey.company.onmicrosoft.com'. The technician re-added the twin 2048-bit DKIM CNAME records (selector1 and selector2) in public DNS, and in Microsoft Defender Security Portal toggled DKIM signing to Enabled under Email & Collaboration > Policies > DKIM. Verification confirmed valid DKIM signatures across all outbound mail streams.

short_description: Teams Rooms console displaying Exchange calendar unavailable from basic auth block
description: Conference room Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) touch consoles showed 'Can't connect to Exchange' banner, preventing one-touch meeting joins.
resolution: Review of sign-in telemetry in Entra ID showed the MTR console attempting to use Basic Authentication to connect to Exchange Web Services (EWS). Basic auth had been permanently deprecated across the tenant. The technician updated the MTR device software to version 4.19, which natively enforces Modern Authentication (MSAL / OAuth 2.0). The device re-authenticated with its resource account and retrieved calendar bookings instantly, restoring one-touch join.

short_description: Outlook mobile app MAM policy wiping corporate email after biometric timeout
description: Traveling sales agents reported that the Outlook app on their personal iPhones spontaneously wiped all corporate emails, prompting for full re-login.
resolution: Analysis of Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM) App Protection Policies showed 'Offline grace period' was configured for 12 hours with wipe action. Agents on long flights without cellular data exceeded the 12-hour offline threshold, triggering an automated selective wipe of enterprise data. The technician adjusted the MAM policy offline grace period to 72 hours under Intune > Apps > App Protection Policies > iOS Policy > Conditional Launch. Outlook data remained preserved through international travel.

short_description: Exchange Online transport rule regex typo routing valid invoices to quarantine
description: Finance vendors complained that payment invoices sent to 'invoices@company.com' received no response; finance staff confirmed no emails had arrived in 3 days.
resolution: Message trace in Exchange Admin Center ('Get-MessageTrace -RecipientAddress invoices@company.com') showed messages being caught by Transport Rule 'SEC-BLOCK-SPOOF' with action 'Redirect to Quarantine'. A newly added regex intended to block '.xyz' domains had an unescaped dot and missing anchor ('.*'), accidentally matching any subject line containing the letter sequence. The technician corrected the regex pattern in the transport rule and released 420 legitimate vendor invoices from quarantine to the finance inbox.

short_description: Microsoft Purview DLP policy false-positive blocking HR salary spreadsheets
description: HR compensation team was blocked from sharing internal compensation modeling workbooks via OneDrive, receiving policy tip 'Blocked by Organization Policy: Credit Card Numbers'.
resolution: Audit of the Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) incident log showed that 16-digit employee health insurance member IDs in column F triggered the built-in 'Credit Card Number' Sensitive Information Type (SIT) regex. The technician updated the DLP rule condition to require supporting keywords ('MasterCard, Visa, CVV') with 85% confidence rather than regex match alone, and added an HR department document exception. HR successfully shared the workbook with zero false-positive blocks.

short_description: Shared mailbox Send As permission delay causing NDR 550 5.7.139
description: Customer support agents granted permission to send from 'help@company.com' received NDR '550 5.7.139 SmtpSendAsDenied; user not allowed to send as this sender'.
resolution: Diagnostics confirmed that 'SendAs' permissions were assigned via Azure Active Directory sync, which has a known token replication latency of up to 2 hours in Exchange Online Directory Services. To bypass the replication delay, the technician executed 'Add-RecipientPermission -Identity help@company.com -Trustee agent@company.com -AccessRights SendAs' directly via Exchange Online PowerShell and instructed the user to restart Outlook in Online Mode temporarily. The user sent emails as 'help@company.com' successfully.

short_description: OneDrive Known Folder Move failure on Desktop folder with error 0x80070057
description: New employee onboarding laptop failed to redirect Desktop and Documents folders to OneDrive cloud backup, reporting error 0x80070057.
resolution: Review of OneDrive diagnostic logs ('%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\OneDrive\logs') showed error 'KFM_FAILED_INVALID_PATH'. A legacy GPO had mapped the local Desktop directory to a secondary partition (D:\Desktop) which did not exist on the new single-NVMe laptop model. The technician restored the default user shell folder registry paths under 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders' to '%USERPROFILE%\Desktop' and restarted explorer.exe. OneDrive Known Folder Move redirected Desktop and Documents cleanly.

short_description: Outlook calendar appointment double-booking bug from legacy ActiveSync client
description: Executive calendar showed overlapping conflicting appointments without sending conflict alerts; meetings accepted on mobile vanished from desktop Outlook.
resolution: Exchange Online mailbox audit logging showed concurrent calendar updates originating from a legacy third-party iOS mail client utilizing Exchange ActiveSync (EAS) v14. EAS does not support modern calendar synchronization conflict resolution protocols. The technician removed the EAS device partnership via 'Remove-MobileDevice', deployed Microsoft Outlook for iOS via Intune with REST-based synchronization, and restored corrupted appointments from the cloud Recoverable Items folder. Calendar synchronization achieved 100% parity.

short_description: Microsoft Viva Insights Outlook add-in causing desktop client crash on startup
description: Outlook 365 crashed immediately upon launch for multiple marketing employees with error 'Outlook experienced a serious problem with the Viva Insights add-in'.
resolution: Crash dumps indicated an unhandled JavaScript exception in the WebView2 host process of the Viva Insights COM add-in. The technician launched Outlook in Safe Mode ('outlook.exe /safe'), navigated to File > Options > Add-ins > COM Add-ins, unchecked 'Viva Insights', and cleared the Office Web Add-ins cache in '%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Wef'. Upon standard relaunch, Outlook started in 3 seconds without crashes. The updated stable add-in manifest was redeployed via Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

short_description: Exchange Online Retention Policy not archiving due to suspended ManagedFolderAssistant
description: Employee's primary mailbox was full (99GB), but emails older than 2 years were not moving to the In-Place Archive as dictated by corporate retention policy.
resolution: Diagnostics via 'Get-Mailbox user@company.com | fl RetentionHoldEnabled, ElcProcessingDisabled' showed 'ElcProcessingDisabled : True'. A previous litigation hold configuration script had inadvertently disabled the Event-Driven Life-Cycle (ELC) processing assistant for this mailbox. The technician re-enabled processing via 'Set-Mailbox user@company.com -ElcProcessingDisabled $false' and triggered an immediate archive run with 'Start-ManagedFolderAssistant user@company.com'. Within two hours, 45GB of archived mail moved to the In-Place Archive.

short_description: SharePoint Online external guest sharing link expiration blocking vendor upload
description: External audit firm was unable to upload annual tax audit files to a shared SharePoint folder, receiving 'This link has expired or you do not have permission'.
resolution: SharePoint Admin audit logs showed that corporate security governance enforces a strict 30-day expiration policy on anonymous and guest sharing links. The link generated for the external auditor had lapsed. The internal compliance manager regenerated the link with authenticated 'Specific People' access, added the auditors' verified corporate email addresses, and configured 60-day access with SMS verification. The external auditors accessed the folder and uploaded the required audit packages.

short_description: Teams meeting recording upload failure caused by tenant SharePoint quota limit
description: All-company town hall meeting recording failed to process in Microsoft Teams, displaying 'Recording failed to upload to SharePoint. Recording will expire in 20 days'.
resolution: SharePoint Admin Center showed tenant storage consumption at 100% of the allocated 25TB pool, causing Teams meeting recording uploads (which save to OneDrive or SharePoint) to fail. The technician temporarily purchased 5TB of supplemental SharePoint storage through M365 Admin Center, ran a PowerShell script to purge the second-stage recycle bin of deleted site collections, and downloaded the meeting recording from temporary Azure blob storage. The recording was published to the corporate town hall stream channel.

short_description: Outlook Roaming Signatures feature conflict overwriting branch disclaimers
description: Legal compliance team discovered that regional branch office employee email signatures were losing mandatory localized regulatory disclosure footers.
resolution: Microsoft introduced 'Outlook Roaming Signatures', which stores email signatures in the cloud mailbox instead of local Outlook profiles, overwriting third-party centralized signature templates. The technician deployed an administrative GPO/Intune registry setting under 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\Setup' setting 'DisableRoamingSignaturesTemporaryToggle' to 1. Corporate mail flow transport rules were configured to automatically append server-side regulatory disclaimers to all outgoing emails, ensuring complete compliance.

short_description: Microsoft Forms survey response sync failure to connected Excel workbook
description: Employee satisfaction survey responses were recorded in Microsoft Forms, but the connected Excel Online live spreadsheet stopped receiving new rows.
resolution: Diagnostics in Microsoft Forms revealed that the Power Automate cloud flow driving real-time row insertion had failed due to a schema change; a user had manually edited column headers in the target Excel workbook. The technician opened Microsoft Forms > Responses, clicked 'Sync all responses to a new workbook', and generated a clean Excel sheet in SharePoint. All 850 existing survey responses backfilled into the new workbook within 2 minutes, and real-time syncing resumed.

short_description: Exchange Online anti-phishing quarantine blocking critical vendor PO attachment
description: Manufacturing purchasing manager could not access a $250,000 capital equipment purchase order PDF, which was blocked by Exchange Online Protection as malware.
resolution: Review in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Threat Explorer revealed that the vendor's PDF contained an embedded JavaScript macro for signature stamping that triggered the 'High Confidence Phish / Malicious Attachment' detonation verdict. The technician submitted the file hash to Microsoft Security Intelligence for false-positive re-analysis, verified the sender's SPF/DKIM authentication, released the message from Quarantine to the recipient with administrative override, and whitelisted the vendor domain. The purchase order was signed and processed.

short_description: Windows Autopilot Enrollment Status Page timeout 0x800705b4 during onboarding
description: New hires unboxing Lenovo ThinkPad laptops experienced provisioning failure during out-of-box experience, with the screen halting on 'Identifying apps (0 of 12)' and timing out with error 0x800705b4.
resolution: Diagnostics on the device via Shift+F10 console inspecting '%ProgramData%\Microsoft\IntuneManagementExtension\Logs\IntuneManagementExtension.log' revealed that a mandatory large CAD application installer was exceeding the 60-minute Enrollment Status Page (ESP) timeout threshold. The technician unassigned the non-essential CAD app from the initial Autopilot blocking profile in Microsoft Intune Admin Center, setting it to install post-logon. The technician restarted the Autopilot deployment via 'systemreset -cleanpc'. The laptop completed device preparation in 14 minutes, reaching the user desktop.

short_description: Jamf Pro macOS configuration profile payload signature error
description: Engineering MacBooks failed to receive updated corporate Wi-Fi and 802.1X certificates, with macOS notifying 'The profile "Corp-Security-Payload" could not be installed'.
resolution: Inspecting client logs on a target Mac via 'sudo jamf log' showed error code -1004 ('Invalid profile signature'). The Jamf Pro built-in Tomcat web server signing certificate used to cryptographically sign MDM mobileconfig payloads had expired. In Jamf Pro Settings > Global Management > PKI Certificates, the technician renewed the Jamf Pro Built-in CA signing key and flushed the APNs push queue. Running 'sudo jamf manage' and 'sudo jamf recon' on client endpoints forced immediate profile re-download, successfully installing the Wi-Fi profile.

short_description: CrowdStrike Falcon sensor false-positive network containment on developer laptop
description: A software engineer's laptop was suddenly disconnected from the corporate network, with CrowdStrike Falcon alerting 'Host has been network contained due to suspicious process execution'.
resolution: CrowdStrike Falcon console inspection showed a High severity detection: 'Suspicious Execution via PowerShell'. The engineer had run an obfuscated build script that generated compiled C++ test payloads in the temp directory, triggering Falcon ML behavior-based containment. The security and IT Support technician reviewed the build script, confirmed it was benign development activity, lifted network containment in the Falcon console, and created an ML Sensor exclusion for the developer's signed workspace directory. The laptop regained network connectivity within 60 seconds.

short_description: Intune BitLocker silent encryption failure on non-admin user logon
description: Security compliance audit flagged 85 newly deployed Windows 11 enterprise laptops as non-compliant because BitLocker silent drive encryption failed to activate.
resolution: Review of Event Viewer under 'Applications and Services Logs > Microsoft > Windows > BitLocker-API' revealed Event ID 851: 'BitLocker cannot silently enable encryption because standard users do not have permissions to enable TPM PIN protectors'. The Intune Endpoint Security disk encryption profile had 'Allow standard users to enable encryption during Azure AD Join' set to Not Configured. The technician toggled this setting to 'Yes' and enabled 256-bit XTS-AES encryption. Upon the next background policy sync, BitLocker encrypted all drives silently and escrowed recovery keys to Entra ID.

short_description: Defender for Endpoint Network Protection blocking internal staging API
description: Quality assurance testers were blocked from testing internal API endpoint 'staging-api.corp.internal', with Microsoft Defender displaying 'This site has been blocked by your network administrator'.
resolution: Defender for Endpoint portal logs showed the newly registered internal domain was flagged as 'Unrated / Malicious URL' by SmartScreen Web Content Filtering. The technician navigated to Microsoft Defender XDR > Settings > Endpoints > Indicators > URLs/Domains, submitted 'staging-api.corp.internal' as an explicit 'Allow' indicator, and assigned it to all workstation device groups. On client laptops, running 'mpcmdrun.exe -RemoveDefinitions -All' followed by 'mpcmdrun.exe -SignatureUpdate' pulled the updated cloud intelligence. QA testers accessed the staging API without blocks.

short_description: Removable storage restriction policy blocking encrypted USB for lab firmware
description: Systems engineers in the testing lab were unable to update air-gapped server firmware because corporate USB ports displayed 'Access Denied' when inserting authorized Kingston IronKey drives.
resolution: Event Viewer showed Event ID 1000 under 'Microsoft-Windows-DeviceSetupManager' logging policy enforcement: Intune Administrative Template 'Removable Disks: Deny read access' was active. The technician created a reusable device group in Microsoft Intune containing the hardware Device ID (USB\VID_0951&PID_1666) of the hardware-encrypted IronKey USB models and created an exclusion rule in the Endpoint Privilege Management policy. The updated policy synchronized to the lab workstations via 'dsregcmd /forcerecovery'. Engineers accessed the USB drives successfully.

short_description: Jamf Pro FileVault disk encryption recovery key escrow failure on macOS
description: Security compliance report showed 45 executive MacBooks with FileVault enabled locally, but without Personal Recovery Keys (PRK) escrowed in Jamf Pro.
resolution: Running 'fdesetup status' on target Macs showed FileVault was On, but 'fdesetup hasrecoverykey' returned false for MDM institutional escrow. Users had manually activated FileVault before the Jamf MDM profile was received. The technician deployed a Jamf policy with the 'Escrow Personal Recovery Key' payload using the command 'fdesetup changerecovery -norecoverykey -user <username>'. The policy prompted users for their macOS logon password once, generated a new PRK, and securely escrowed the cryptographic key into the Jamf Pro database.

short_description: Intune Win32 app deployment exit code 1603 failing AnyConnect client rollout
description: Automated deployment of Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) failed across 200 Windows 10 laptops, showing status 'Failed' with error code 0x87D1041C (1603).
resolution: Inspection of Intune Management Extension agent log ('IntuneManagementExtension.log') and MSI install log showed Windows Installer error 1603 (Fatal error during installation) caused by a locked Network Adapter NDIS filter driver. The technician updated the Win32 app package installation script to include silent lock handling and forced driver override ('msiexec.exe /i anyconnect-win.msi /qn /norestart NO_DESKTOP_ICON=1 PRE_DEPLOY=1 ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT=1'). The updated .intunewin package deployed smoothly across all 200 endpoints with a 99% success rate.

short_description: Apple Automated Device Enrollment token expiration halting zero-touch Mac setup
description: IT provisioning team opening newly delivered Apple M3 MacBook Pros found that machines skipped the Remote Management screen during Setup Assistant, booting as unmanaged devices.
resolution: Review of Jamf Pro Settings > Global Management > Automated Device Enrollment showed the Apple Business Manager (ABM) server token had expired after its 365-day validity cycle. Communication between Jamf and Apple ADE servers was severed. In Apple Business Manager, the technician downloaded a renewed Server Token (.p7m), uploaded it to Jamf Pro, and synchronized device assignments. The technician reset the new MacBooks ('Erase All Content and Settings'); Setup Assistant successfully displayed the Remote Management screen and zero-touch enrollment executed.

short_description: Intune compliance false-alarm from disabled Connected User Experiences telemetry
description: Over 60 employee laptops were blocked from corporate email by Conditional Access because Intune flagged them as non-compliant for 'Operating system version'.
resolution: Diagnostics showed the laptops were running the latest Windows 11 23H2 build, but Intune reported OS version as 'Unknown'. A third-party privacy optimization utility had disabled the Windows service 'Connected User Experiences and Telemetry' ('DiagTrack'). Without DiagTrack, the Intune Management Extension could not report local build numbers back to Microsoft Graph API. The technician deployed an administrative script setting 'DiagTrack' service startup type to Automatic ('sc config DiagTrack start=auto && sc start DiagTrack'). Device compliance updated to Compliant within 15 minutes.

short_description: CrowdStrike Falcon sensor in Reduced Functionality Mode after Linux kernel upgrade
description: Production Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 application servers alerted with Critical EDR status: 'Falcon Sensor RFM - Kernel incompatible'.
resolution: Checking Falcon status via '/opt/CrowdStrike/falconctl -g --rfm-state' confirmed 'rfm-state=true'. An automated Yum security update installed Linux kernel 5.14.0-427, which was not yet supported by the installed Falcon sensor v7.08. In the CrowdStrike Falcon console under Host Setup and Management > Sensor Update Policies, the technician updated the Linux production policy to auto-upgrade to Falcon sensor v7.14 (which includes eBPF support for kernel 5.14.0-427). The sensor upgraded, exited RFM, and restored full behavioral protection.

short_description: Android Enterprise Dedicated Device kiosk crash loop after Play Services update
description: Handheld warehouse barcode scanning tablets running Android Enterprise Dedicated Device (kiosk mode) rebooted continuously into a black lock screen.
resolution: Crash logs extracted via Android Debug Bridge ('adb logcat') showed the custom warehouse inventory app crashing because a Google Play Services update deprecated a location API used during kiosk startup. In Microsoft Intune Admin Center under Devices > Android > Configuration Profiles > Kiosk Settings, the technician temporarily added Chrome to the single-app kiosk allow-list as a multi-app fallback and pushed a hotfixed APK provided by the software vendor. The tablets exited the crash loop and warehouse shipments resumed.

short_description: Intune SCEP certificate enrollment failure from NDES HTTP 500 error
description: Newly onboarded iPhones and iPads were unable to connect to the internal enterprise Wi-Fi network; SCEP certificate profiles showed state 'Error'.
resolution: Intune connector logs on the on-premises Network Device Enrollment Service (NDES) server showed HTTP 500 Internal Server Error when processing SCEP certificate requests. The service account running the NDES Application Pool had an expired password, preventing communication with the Active Directory Certificate Authority (ADCS). The technician updated the NDES service account password in Active Directory, reconfigured IIS Application Pool identity credentials, and restarted IIS ('iisreset'). SCEP certificate enrollment succeeded across all pending iOS devices.

short_description: Jamf Pro Self Service failing to load policy scripts from corrupt local cache
description: Mac users clicking 'Install Developer Tools' in Jamf Self Service encountered indefinite spinning wheels followed by error 'Policy failed to execute'.
resolution: Review of client logs in '/private/var/log/jamf.log' showed SQLite database locks on '/Library/Application Support/JAMF/Jamf.db'. A hard shutdown during a previous package download left corrupt temp files in the staging folder. The technician executed a cleanup script via Jamf remote management that removed the locked SQLite cache ('sudo rm -rf /Library/Application\ Support/JAMF/Jamf.db*'), cleared '/Library/Application Support/JAMF/Downloads', and restarted the Jamf daemon. Self Service re-indexed and successfully installed developer tools.

short_description: Windows Defender Application Control WDAC blocking IT maintenance PowerShell
description: Helpdesk technicians deploying remote maintenance scripts via PowerShell were blocked on Windows 11 endpoints with error 'This script cannot be run in ConstrainedLanguage mode'.
resolution: Code integrity audit logs under 'Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational' confirmed that Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) enforced Constrained Language Mode because the maintenance script was unsigned. The technician updated the continuous integration deployment pipeline to sign all administrative PowerShell scripts using the enterprise Code Signing Certificate from the internal PKI ('Set-AuthenticodeSignature -Certificate $cert'). Signed scripts executed with full FullLanguage privileges under WDAC enforcement.

short_description: macOS TCC privacy prompt cascade blocking endpoint backup agent
description: Enterprise cloud backup client CrashPlan was unable to back up user files on macOS Sonoma, constantly prompting users with 'CrashPlan would like to access files in your Desktop folder'.
resolution: macOS Transparency, Consent, and Control (TCC) requires a mobileconfig profile granting 'SystemPolicyAllFiles' (Full Disk Access) to background backup services. The CrashPlan application binary path had changed in version 11.2, invalidating the previous TCC profile. In Jamf Pro, the technician updated the Privacy Preferences Policy Control (PPPC) profile with the new code requirement signature ('identifier "com.crashplan.app" and anchor apple generic') and pushed the configuration. Full Disk Access was granted automatically without prompting users.

short_description: Intune Windows LAPS password rotation failure from missing AD write rights
description: IT Security audit reported that 120 Entra hybrid-joined workstations failed Windows Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) rotation, leaving stale default admin credentials.
resolution: Event Viewer on client machines showed LAPS Event ID 10034: 'The LAPS policy failed to write the password to Active Directory: Access is denied'. The Organizational Unit (OU) containing the computer accounts lacked write permissions for the 'msLAPS-Password' and 'msLAPS-PasswordExpirationTime' schema attributes. The technician ran 'Set-LapsADComputerSelfPermission -Identity "OU=Workstations,DC=corp,DC=internal"' in PowerShell to grant computer self-permission. LAPS successfully generated, rotated, and escrowed unique complex passwords.

short_description: Jamf Pro restricted software policy terminating unauthorized virtualization app
description: Contract developer complained that VirtualBox spontaneously terminated every time they launched it, with a popup notification 'VirtualBox has been closed by IT policy'.
resolution: Jamf Pro log audit showed Restricted Software Policy 'RESTRICT-UNAPPROVED-HYPERVISORS' triggered upon detecting process 'VirtualBox.app'. Corporate policy strictly mandates VMware Fusion or UTM for licensed development environments. The technician informed the contractor of software compliance guidelines, guided them to install approved VMware Fusion from Jamf Self Service with an enterprise corporate license key, and verified that development virtual machines imported and operated smoothly.

short_description: CrowdStrike Falcon isolation blocking IT remote desktop management sessions
description: IT Support technicians were unable to connect via Quick Assist, RDP, or SSH to a quarantined laptop in Building E to remediate an adware infection.
resolution: When CrowdStrike Falcon executes network containment, all inbound and outbound traffic is severed except for encrypted telemetry to the CrowdStrike Cloud. To remediate the device remotely without releasing it to the production LAN, the technician utilized Falcon Real Time Response (RTR) console ('runscript -CloudFile="clean_adware.ps1"') to eradicate the unwanted adware files, verify registry keys, and inspect running processes. Once remediation was verified, network containment was lifted.

short_description: Intune App Protection Policy blocking copy-paste between Word and web browser
description: Executive assistant could not copy text from corporate Word documents into the travel booking website in Safari on their company iPad, receiving 'Your organization data cannot be pasted here'.
resolution: Inspection of Microsoft Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM) App Protection Policy for iOS confirmed that 'Restrict cut, copy, and paste between other apps' was configured for 'Policy managed apps only with paste in'. Safari is an unmanaged native app, blocking data transfer. The technician guided the assistant to open the company-approved managed Microsoft Edge mobile browser on the iPad, which operates within the encrypted Intune MAM container. Copy-pasting data into the travel booking site in Edge succeeded immediately.

short_description: Apple Push Notification APNs cert expiration halting all iPad MDM management
description: Retail store managers reported that 800 customer POS iPads stopped receiving menu updates and remote app pushes; Jamf Pro showed zero MDM command execution.
resolution: In Jamf Pro Server Settings > Global Management > Push Certificates, the Apple Push Notification service (APNs) MDM certificate was shown as Expired. Without a valid APNs certificate, Apple servers drop all outbound management wake-up notifications to iOS devices. The technician logged into identity.apple.com with the corporate Apple ID, renewed the existing certificate using a CSR generated from Jamf Pro, uploaded the signed .pem file, and saved the settings. Jamf flushed pending queues, successfully pushing updates to all 800 iPads.

short_description: Windows Credential Guard HVCI boot crash on virtual desktop infrastructure
description: Following a quarterly security baseline push, VMware Horizon Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) worker pools crashed with BSOD in SECURE_KERNEL_ERROR.
resolution: Diagnostics identified that Group Policy enabled Windows Defender Credential Guard and Hypervisor-Protected Code Integrity (HVCI), but the underlying VMware ESXi virtual machine hardware version (vHW 14) did not have Virtualization Based Security (VBS) and nested virtualization enabled in the vSphere master image. The technician powered down the master golden image, upgraded virtual hardware to vHW 19, enabled 'Virtualization Based Security' in VM Options, and redeployed the VDI pool. Virtual desktops booted cleanly with full Credential Guard protection active.

short_description: Jamf Pro Smart Group criteria regex error stalling emergency zero-day patch
description: Security team noted that an urgent zero-day Google Chrome security patch deployed via Jamf had only reached 3 out of 1,200 macOS endpoints after 6 hours.
resolution: Examination of the target Jamf Smart Computer Group 'Vulnerable Chrome Endpoints' revealed a regex syntax error: the criteria string was set to 'Application Version matches regex ^12[0-4]' instead of 'is not 125.0.6422.141', resulting in almost all Macs failing group qualification. The technician updated the smart group criteria to 'Application Title has Google Chrome.app' AND 'Application Version is not 125.0.6422.141'. The smart group re-calculated, enrolling 1,180 eligible Macs; the patch executed successfully across the fleet within 45 minutes.

short_description: Intune device wipe pending indefinitely for lost laptop without network access
description: Security operations requested immediate remote wipe of a lost executive laptop, but the Intune Admin Center showed the wipe status stuck in 'Pending' for 24 hours.
resolution: Investigation confirmed that the lost laptop was powered off or offline, preventing it from receiving the MDM wipe push notification from Microsoft Graph. As an immediate defense-in-depth mitigation, the technician revoked all Active Directory and Entra ID user session tokens via PowerShell ('Revoke-AzureADUserAllRefreshToken'), disabled the device object in Entra ID to block token renewal, and rotated the executive's enterprise credentials. The wipe command remained queued in Intune, configured to immediately trigger hardware formatting if the device reconnects to Wi-Fi.

short_description: Trellix EDR high CPU scanning unexcluded IDE build output directories
description: Full-stack web developers experienced extreme compile slowdowns; npm build and Docker image compilations took 40 minutes instead of 3 minutes with Trellix consuming 100% CPU.
resolution: Performance telemetry on developer workstations revealed that the Trellix (McAfee) Endpoint Security on-access scanner was intercepting every single file creation inside 'node_modules', 'target', and '.git' directories during builds. The technician updated the Trellix ePO On-Access Scan policy for the Engineering organizational group, adding low-risk process exclusions for 'node.exe', 'git.exe', and 'code.exe', and excluded development root paths ('C:\Source\Repos\*'). NPM build times dropped back to 3 minutes with Trellix CPU under 5%.

short_description: Cisco StackWise switch stack split and flex-cable failure in distribution warehouse
description: Core access switch stack in DC-4 logistics warehouse went unreachable during early morning operations. Barcode scanners and shipping label printers dropped off the network. Monitoring reported switch stack election failure and member isolation.
resolution: Diagnostics via 'show switch', 'show switch stack-ring detail', and 'show switch stack-ports' revealed that member 2 and member 3 lost communication due to a damaged StackWise flex-cable, causing a dual-master stack split. The engineer replaced the damaged StackWise flex-cable, verified stack-ring redundancy with full 32Gbps bandwidth restored, and configured 'switch 1 priority 15' to ensure deterministic stack master election. All access ports and warehouse clients reconnected with zero errors.

short_description: Ingress Gateway VIP TLS handshake failure due to missing DigiCert Intermediate CA bundle
description: External merchant systems uploading batch onboarding data via Ingress HTTPS endpoints reported SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL and TLS handshake timeouts. F5 BIG-IP load balancer logged excessive unfinished client handshakes and unrecognized certificate authority errors.
resolution: Testing via 'openssl s_client -connect api.merchant-onboard.com:443 -showcerts' identified that the F5 BIG-IP SSL Client Profile was configured with only the leaf server certificate without the DigiCert Intermediate CA bundle, causing mobile and external clients to terminate TLS 1.3 negotiation. The engineer downloaded the DigiCert Global Root G2 Intermediate certificate, concatenated it into a complete PEM bundle, bound the bundle to the Client SSL Profile, and optimized cipher suites to modern TLS 1.3 specs. Handshakes completed cleanly with zero SSL errors.

short_description: Path MTU Discovery black-hole dropping large database replication packets over MPLS
description: Inter-datacenter database backup replication and rsync transfers across the secondary MPLS circuit stalled indefinitely when packet payloads exceeded 1460 bytes. Small ICMP pings succeeded, but database sync sessions hung at 0% after initial TCP handshake.
resolution: Network engineers ran 'ping -s 1472 -M do 10.200.1.1' which failed, pinpointing an MTU black-hole where transit routers silently dropped packets exceeding path MTU without returning ICMP Type 3 Code 4 (Fragmentation Needed) packets. The engineer applied TCP MSS clamping via 'ip tcp adjust-mss 1360' on both MPLS endpoint sub-interfaces and enabled Path MTU Discovery. Retesting confirmed 100% transmission of 1500-byte packets and sustained multi-gigabit replication throughput.

short_description: LACP Port-Channel flapping and intermittent packet drops due to timer mismatch and degraded SFP+
description: Core switch distribution link (Port-Channel 10) experienced 15-20% packet drops and state flapping during inter-DC replication bursts. Interface statistics reported frequent LACP partner timeout events.
resolution: Diagnostics via 'show lacp neighbor' and 'show interfaces transceiver detail' revealed an LACP heartbeat rate mismatch (local switch set to 'lacp rate fast' 1s, remote peer set to 'lacp rate slow' 30s) combined with an optically degraded 10G SFP+ optic on member interface TenGigabitEthernet 1/0/2 reporting -18 dBm Rx optical power. The engineer replaced the faulty transceiver module and synchronized LACP timers across both endpoints. Port-Channel stability was fully restored with 0 drops.

short_description: Anycast DNS BIRD daemon health check failure withdrawing POP routing prefix from BGP
description: Anycast DNS nameserver node in the Dallas POP stopped receiving external queries. BGP route telemetry showed 100% of global DNS traffic diverted to distant secondary POPs, tripling query latency for central US clients.
resolution: Diagnostics in BIRD routing daemon logs ('/var/log/bird.log') showed that the health-check probe script failed due to a locked named query socket, causing BIRD to withdraw the Anycast /32 prefix from upstream BGP transit peers. The engineer restarted the BIRD daemon, added socket timeout handling to the health-check script, and verified BGP prefix re-announcement ('birdc show route for 198.51.100.53'). Anycast traffic redistributed with latency dropping back to sub-15ms.

short_description: Guest Wi-Fi captive portal redirection failure due to pre-authentication DNS ACL drop
description: Visitors connecting to 'Corporate-Guest' Wi-Fi in the main lobby were unable to load the captive portal terms-of-service page. Smartphones connected to SSID but showed 'No Internet Connection' without displaying the automatic web sign-in popup.
resolution: Review of Cisco WLC FlexConnect ACLs revealed that the pre-authentication ACL was dropping UDP port 53 DNS traffic destined for external public resolvers (8.8.8.8) and TCP 8443 traffic redirected to Cisco ISE. The engineer updated the pre-auth redirect ACL on the Cisco WLC to permit UDP port 53 and redirected HTTPS traffic, allowing smartphone Captive Network Assistant (CNA) probes to reach the ISE guest portal smoothly.

short_description: IPsec site-to-site VPN tunnel rekeying failure caused by PFS proposal mismatch
description: Site-to-site IPsec VPN tunnel connecting corporate HQ to third-party logistics warehouse dropped every 8 hours exactly. Tunnel renegotiation failed and required manual session clearance to restore communication.
resolution: Log analysis via 'show crypto ipsec sa' and 'show log | include IPSEC' revealed a Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) mismatch during Phase 2 Security Association (SA) rekeying: the central ASA enforced PFS Group 14 (Diffie-Hellman 2048-bit), while the remote warehouse router had PFS Group 2 configured in its crypto map. The engineer updated the remote crypto map to 'set pfs group14' and synchronized lifetime parameters to 28800 seconds. Automated rekeying completed successfully over a 24-hour test window.

short_description: GlobalProtect VPN session termination every 15 minutes due to DPD timeout
description: Remote engineering staff connecting to the corporate network via Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN reported consistent disconnections every 15 minutes, interrupting database administration and remote SSH sessions.
resolution: Diagnostics on Palo Alto Firewall GlobalProtect gateway logs showed that aggressive Dead Peer Detection (DPD) with a 60-second timeout was terminating tunnels whenever home internet latency spikes delayed 3 consecutive keepalives. The engineer adjusted the gateway DPD hello interval to 30s / retry 5, relaxed the inactivity disconnect timeout, and pushed an updated client configuration. Remote connections remained stable across home broadband variations.

short_description: DHCP scope exhaustion on staging and guest VLANs blocking new device leases
description: New IoT barcode scanners and staging workstations in production staging facility failed to obtain IP addresses, falling back to 169.254.x.x link-local addresses. DHCP server rejected discovery requests with 'Scope full'.
resolution: Inspection of Windows DHCP server statistics ('Get-DhcpServerv4Scope -ScopeId 10.100.20.0') showed 100% address utilization due to an overly long 7-day lease time for transient mobile devices. The engineer purged inactive and expired leases, reduced the lease duration to 4 hours for the staging VLAN, and expanded the subnet allocation from /24 to /22 (1,020 usable hosts). Devices immediately acquired valid DHCP leases.

short_description: OSPF neighbor adjacency stuck in ExStart/Exchange due to interface MTU mismatch
description: New distribution switch sw-dist-03 failed to establish full OSPF routing adjacency with the datacenter core router. Routing tables were incomplete and traffic failed to route across the new distribution link.
resolution: Diagnostics via 'show ip ospf neighbor' indicated neighbor state was stuck in ExStart/Exchange. Interface inspection ('show interface TenGigabitEthernet 1/0/1') showed the new switch had MTU 9000 enabled while the core router interface was configured with default MTU 1500; OSPF Database Description (DBD) packets exceeding 1500 bytes were dropped. The engineer standardized the interface MTU to 1500, cleared the OSPF process, and verified adjacency transitioned cleanly to FULL.

short_description: POS thermal receipt printer offline due to Print Spooler deadlock and serial COM baud rate mismatch
description: Register 3 POS thermal receipt printer stopped printing receipts and made repetitive error beeps. Credit card transactions completed successfully in software, but customer receipts failed to print, creating checkout bottlenecks.
resolution: The technician stopped the Windows Print Spooler service ('net stop spooler') and found corrupted raw spool files in 'C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS'. Device Manager inspection revealed that the virtual COM3 port baud rate was misconfigured to 9600 bps instead of 115200 bps expected by the Epson TM-T88 driver. The technician deleted stale spool files, adjusted the COM3 baud rate to 115200 bps with 8-N-1 flow control, restarted the Print Spooler, and performed a test print, restoring full thermal receipt printing.

short_description: Okta SAML claims group attribute out of sync blocking CRM elevated approver permissions
description: Newly promoted Regional Sales Manager was unable to approve merchant fee waivers exceeding $5,000 in CRM/Salesforce. Clicking 'Approve' threw 'Permission Denied: Insufficient Privileges to Execute Action'.
resolution: Audited Okta SAML 2.0 application claims and Active Directory security groups. Discovered that the user had been added to the AD group 'CRM-Tier2-Approvers', but an Okta SCIM sync interruption prevented the SAML group claim attribute from synchronizing into Salesforce. The technician triggered an Okta SCIM directory delta sync, confirmed the SAML assertion contained 'CRM-Tier2-Approvers' under group attributes, and verified the user successfully executed the fee waiver approval.

short_description: Merchant agreement e-sign WebView white screen caused by corrupted localStorage and CSRF token collision
description: Merchant onboarding agents using company-issued tablets reported that tapping 'Sign & Submit Agreement' on customer tablets produced a completely blank white screen. No confirmation email or agreement PDF was generated.
resolution: Remote browser inspection of the tablet WebView console revealed an unhandled JavaScript exception: stale JSON in 'window.localStorage' collided with an updated CSRF token validation script in the web application bundle. The technician cleared the tablet application cache and localStorage via MDM configuration profile, deployed the updated webview bundle (v3.4.1), and verified successful e-signature submission and PDF generation.

short_description: Automated onboarding welcome emails bouncing with 554 Relay Access Denied
description: Newly onboarded merchants did not receive automated welcome emails containing portal setup credentials. Mail server logs reported outbound bounce errors with '554 5.7.1 Relay access denied'.
resolution: Log review on the Postfix internal SMTP relay server showed that newly scaled onboarding worker nodes were provisioned in a new subnet ('10.50.12.0/24') that was missing from the Postfix 'mynetworks' trusted IP whitelist. The technician added the new worker subnet to 'mynetworks' in '/etc/postfix/main.cf', reloaded the postfix service ('postfix reload'), and flushed the mail queue ('postqueue -f'). All pending onboarding welcome emails were successfully delivered.

short_description: Lenel OnGuard RFID server room access badge rejected due to annual credential expiration
description: Lead systems engineer physical RFID access badge was rejected with triple denial beeps at the 4th floor IT server room reader, preventing emergency access to the datacenter racks.
resolution: The security technician checked Lenel OnGuard System Administration Access Events, which showed 'Card Rejected: Credential Expired'. The physical badge credential record had passed its mandatory 1-year security expiration date. The technician extended the credential validity date in Lenel OnGuard, verified the engineer's 'Tier-3 Datacenter Access' badge clearance, downloaded the updated database to the 4th floor field controller, and confirmed immediate server room door unlock.

short_description: Network shared printer installation blocked with error 0x0000011b on Windows workstations
description: Finance department workstations were unable to connect to the shared departmental laser printer, reporting error 'Windows cannot connect to the printer - Operation failed with error 0x0000011b'.
resolution: Identified that a recent Windows cumulative security patch enforced Point and Print RPC privacy encryption ('RpcAuthnLevelPrivacyEnabled') on the print spooler, which the legacy print server did not negotiate. The technician applied GPO registry setting 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Print\RpcAuthnLevelPrivacyEnabled = 0' as a temporary mitigation, restarted the Print Spooler service across endpoints, and scheduled a migration to modern Type-4 print drivers. Printer mapping succeeded immediately for all finance users.

short_description: BitLocker recovery key prompt on startup while traveling internationally
description: Executive traveling in Tokyo was locked out of company laptop upon boot; Windows displayed the BitLocker Recovery screen requesting a 48-digit key after an airport dock firmware trigger.
resolution: The IT service desk verified executive identity via out-of-band video call with executive assistance. The technician retrieved the 48-digit BitLocker recovery key from Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) admin center under device properties, guided the user through keyboard entry, and logged in successfully. Upon VPN connection, the technician refreshed the TPM platform configuration registers ('manage-bde -protectors -delete' and '-add -tpm') to prevent recurring recovery prompts.

short_description: Continuous Multi-Factor Authentication prompt loop on Microsoft 365 desktop applications
description: Marketing department users were repeatedly prompted to approve Microsoft Authenticator notifications every 5 minutes across Outlook, Teams, and Word desktop apps, interrupting productivity.
resolution: Investigation in Microsoft Entra ID Conditional Access policies revealed that an administrator had mistakenly configured 'Sign-in frequency' to 5 minutes instead of 8 hours on the cloud app session control policy. The technician updated the Conditional Access policy to enforce a 12-hour session lifetime with persistent browser cookies, pushed the policy refresh, and cleared cached identity tokens on affected client machines ('dsregcmd /leave' and '/join'). MFA prompt loops ceased completely.

short_description: YubiKey FIDO2 hardware token not recognized in macOS Sonoma WebAuthn prompts
description: Engineers using macOS Sonoma workstations were unable to authenticate into AWS Console or Okta using YubiKey 5C NFC security keys. Safari and Chrome reported 'Security key not recognized or timed out'.
resolution: Log analysis in macOS Console showed CCID smartcard daemon communication failures following the macOS 14.3 update. The technician deployed a Jamf Pro configuration profile enabling CCID smartcard entitlements and set Chrome enterprise policy 'WebAuthenticationPermitEnterpriseAttestation = true'. The technician also updated YubiKey Manager firmware to 5.4.3. Hardware token FIDO2 WebAuthn prompts functioned reliably across all browsers.

short_description: Windows Autopilot laptop provisioning ESP timeout during customer onboarding deployment
description: Newly provisioned Dell laptops for customer onboarding team stalled for 60+ minutes at 'Device Setup - Installing Applications (1 of 6)' during Windows Autopilot Enrollment Status Page (ESP).
resolution: Investigation of Intune management logs ('%ProgramData%\Microsoft\IntuneManagementExtension\Logs\IntuneManagementExtension.log') showed that an older 32-bit VPN client Win32 package had an interactive MSI installer that hung waiting for user input in the SYSTEM context. The technician re-packaged the application with silent switches '/qn /norestart', updated the Intune required blocking apps list, and re-tested Autopilot enrollment. Provisioning completed from out-of-box to desktop in 17 minutes.

short_description: CoreDNS upstream UDP port exhaustion causing intermittent DNS resolution timeout for microservices
description: Payment processing pods in Kubernetes namespace payments reported intermittent DNS lookup timeouts and NXDOMAIN errors when querying external API endpoints such as api.stripe.com. Pod logs displayed dial tcp lookup api.stripe.com i/o timeout while internal cluster DNS remained partially functional.
resolution: Diagnostics on CoreDNS metrics showed heavy UDP port allocation on the node's local resolver socket, causing CoreDNS upstream forwarder rate-limiting due to UDP port exhaustion on the primary internal resolver node. The engineer auto-scaled CoreDNS replicas from 2 to 6, configured the CoreDNS cache plugin with a 30-second TTL minimum in the Corefile, and directed upstream queries to redundant internal enterprise DNS servers. DNS query latency normalized to <2ms with zero timeouts.

short_description: 5GHz high-density Wi-Fi co-channel interference causing packet loss and VoIP call dropouts
description: Employees on Building B 3rd Floor reported severe audio dropouts and call disconnects during Microsoft Teams video meetings despite full Wi-Fi signal strength bars on laptops. Network monitoring showed high packet jitter and 22% frame retransmissions.
resolution: RF spectrum analysis on the Cisco Catalyst 9800 WLC revealed severe co-channel Wi-Fi interference on 5GHz channels (channels 36 and 40) exceeding 65% channel utilization caused by overlapping access point radio coverage and high channel saturation. The engineer enabled Dynamic Channel Allocation (DCA) with 20MHz channel width, reduced AP transmit power levels from 20 dBm to 14 dBm across Building B 3rd floor, and optimized 5GHz channel distribution. Wi-Fi channel utilization dropped to 18% with zero dropped calls.

short_description: Nginx ingress proxy buffer exhaustion returning HTTP 502 Bad Gateway on large webhook payloads
description: During peak marketing promotional flash sales, external payment provider webhooks received HTTP 502 Bad Gateway when sending notification payloads to the payment webhook listener service. Webhook ingestion traffic spiked from 200 req/s to 4,500 req/s.
resolution: Nginx reverse proxy error logs showed 'upstream sent too big header while reading response header from upstream' and worker process file descriptor exhaustion. The root cause was Nginx proxy buffer exhaustion caused by large JSON payload headers exceeding default buffer sizes and hitting max open file descriptor limits during high traffic. The engineer tuned Nginx configuration with 'proxy_buffer_size 128k', 'proxy_buffers 4 256k', and 'proxy_busy_buffers_size 256k', increased worker_connections to 16384, and reloaded Nginx. Webhook delivery succeeded with 100% 200 OK responses.

short_description: Spanning Tree Protocol TCN storm and network loop triggered by rogue switch without BPDU Guard
description: Top-of-Rack switches in Datacenter Rack 7 experienced 98% control plane CPU spikes and 40% inter-rack packet drops. Servers connected across rack switchports reported sudden network unreachability and flapping link states.
resolution: Diagnostics via 'show spanning-tree detail' identified continuous Topology Change Notification (TCN) floods originating from access port Eth1/24 where an unmanaged laboratory test switch was plugged in with Spanning Tree BPDU Guard disabled. The engineer administratively shut down interface Eth1/24, globally enforced 'spanning-tree bpduguard enable' and 'spanning-tree portfast' on all edge access ports, and stabilized Spanning Tree convergence with 0% packet loss.

short_description: AWS NAT Gateway SNAT port exhaustion causing connection timeouts to external payment APIs
description: Microservices running in private AWS subnets failed to connect to external banking gateway APIs, logging 'connection timed out' and 'dial tcp: address already in use'. Outbound HTTPS requests to payment providers were failing intermittently under load.
resolution: CloudWatch metrics showed ErrorPortAllocation at 100% on the primary AWS NAT Gateway. The root cause was SNAT port exhaustion on the NAT Gateway pool because thousands of concurrent microservice HTTP requests were opening short-lived connections without TCP connection reuse. The engineer allocated two secondary Elastic IPs to the NAT Gateway pool to expand available SNAT ports, and updated application HTTP client configurations with persistent connection pooling and keepalive timeouts. Outbound connection failures dropped to zero.

short_description: Outlook 365 desktop search failure caused by corrupted Windows Search Index database (Windows.edb)
description: Executive assistant reported that searching for emails received in the last 3 weeks returned zero results in Outlook 365 desktop application, while Outlook on the web (OWA) returned complete search results normally.
resolution: Event Viewer logged Event ID 7042 indicating database corruption in Windows.edb. The root cause was a corrupted Windows Search Index database (Windows.edb) following an abrupt system shutdown, preventing Outlook from querying local email caches. The technician navigated to Control Panel > Indexing Options > Advanced, triggered 'Rebuild' to regenerate the Windows Search catalog, restarted the WSearch service, and confirmed instant search queries in Outlook retrieved all recent emails.

short_description: External monitor mirroring fallback over USB-C dock due to outdated DisplayLink graphics driver
description: User plugged a second Dell UltraSharp monitor via USB-C docking station into their corporate HP EliteBook, but Windows Display Settings only displayed duplicate/mirror screen mode, with the 'Extend these displays' option greyed out.
resolution: Device Manager showed the USB-C dock operating under Microsoft Basic Display Adapter. The root cause was an outdated DisplayLink / Intel Graphics driver package that defaulted to fallback VGA mirroring over the DisplayPort-over-USB-C hub. The technician installed the latest DisplayLink docking station driver package and Intel Iris Xe Graphics drivers, power-cycled the dock, and configured Display Settings to 'Extend these displays' at native 2560x1440 resolution.

short_description: Expense report submit button missing in ERP portal due to unassigned cost center ID in user profile
description: Employee attempting to submit monthly travel expense report in the corporate ERP portal discovered the green 'Submit' button was missing from the bottom of the form, preventing reimbursement processing.
resolution: Portal validation logs revealed mandatory routing rule failure 'Cost Center Required'. The root cause was that the user's default cost center ID in the employee profile was unassigned during an internal department transfer, violating the mandatory routing policy requirement before submission. The IT support specialist assigned Department Cost Center code CC-5020 in the employee Workday profile and synced directory permissions, enabling the 'Submit' button immediately.

short_description: OneDrive for Business sync engine stalled with error 0x8004de40 due to locked OfficeFileCache
description: Accounting team workstations running Windows 11 reported OneDrive for Business sync stopped with error 0x8004de40. Local synchronized SharePoint libraries displayed red X sync icons, and changes were not replicating to the cloud.
resolution: Review of %localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\logs confirmed sync engine lockup. The root cause was a locked Office Document Cache temporary database containing conflicting locked handles from an abrupt system shutdown during multi-user co-authoring. The technician ran 'onedrive.exe /reset', deleted locked temporary database files in %localappdata%\Microsoft\Office\16.0\OfficeFileCache, and restarted the OneDrive client. Sync converged and all folders displayed green checkmarks.

short_description: Active Directory LDAPS port 636 SSL handshake failure due to expired Domain Controller certificate
description: Enterprise web applications including Jira, Confluence, and Jenkins reported user login failures with error 'LDAP connection failed: SSL handshake terminated'. Central Active Directory authentication was non-operational over secure LDAPS port 636.
resolution: Diagnostics with 'openssl s_client -connect dc-01.corp.internal:636' showed certificate verification failed: certificate has expired. The root cause was that the server SSL/TLS certificate installed on Domain Controller DC-01 for LDAPS expired, causing client applications to abort TLS validation. The system administrator enrolled and installed a renewed Kerberos Authentication certificate from the internal Microsoft Enterprise Certificate Authority, bound it to the NTDS Service certificate store, and verified LDAPS binds succeeded across all corporate web portals.

short_description: Corporate web portal buttons unresponsive due to rogue Chrome extension blocking DOM events
description: Operations agents reported that inside the internal merchant servicing web portal, clicking 'Approve', 'Edit', or navigation tabs did nothing, with no error messages shown on screen. Browser dev tools showed click events were not reaching backend listeners.
resolution: Browser console inspection showed 'Uncaught TypeError: event.stopPropagation() called by content_script.js'. The root cause was an unauthorized Chrome browser extension that injected an aggressive content script blocking internal DOM click events on the web portal. The technician uninstalled the unauthorized browser extension, deployed an extension blocklist via Google Chrome Enterprise Policy GPO, cleared browser cached site data, and verified all interactive portal buttons worked properly.

short_description: IPsec Phase 2 Security Association lifetime expiration causing branch portal disconnection
description: Staff at regional branch offices report that internal management tools and inventory portals fail with connection timed out while external websites work normally. Diagnostics on the branch edge gateway show IPsec phase-2 Security Association (SA) lifetime expiration preventing automated renegotiation with the central VPN concentrator.
resolution: The root cause was an expired IPsec phase-2 Security Association (SA) lifetime configuration on the branch gateway router, preventing renegotiation with the central VPN concentrator. Diagnostics with 'show crypto ipsec sa' showed SA state expired with 0 active encrypted packets. The engineer cleared stale SAs via 'clear crypto ipsec sa', updated the IKEv2 proposal lifetimes to match the central profile (28800 seconds), and confirmed bidirectional tunnel stability and inventory portal reachability.

short_description: Active Directory service account lockout caused by orphaned scheduled task on decommissioned server
description: The dedicated service account svc-pos-provision gets repeatedly locked out every 15 minutes across domain controllers, disrupting automated POS provisioning pipelines and terminal enrollments.
resolution: The root cause was a decommissioned staging server that still had a scheduled task running with cached, expired credentials for svc-pos-provision, causing repeated bad password attempts against the Domain Controller. The technician inspected Security Event ID 4740 in Event Viewer, identified the caller computer name 'STG-SRV-04', remotely disabled the orphaned background task, and unlocked the svc-pos-provision Active Directory account.

short_description: CRM portal bank routing number field locked due to merchant Audit Hold status
description: Customer service representatives report that the input field for 'Bank Routing Transit Number (ABA)' is completely greyed out and uneditable for existing merchants requesting banking detail updates in the CRM portal.
resolution: The root cause was a conditional UI field-lock triggered because the merchant record was in 'Audit Hold' status, requiring an approved Change Request workflow before inline banking edits are permitted. The support specialist verified the compliance record, initiated the standard banking Change Request approval workflow in the compliance portal, and upon supervisor approval, the banking transit fields unlocked for editing.

short_description: Office WAN circuit saturation and sluggish internet caused by unthrottled backup synchronization
description: Users in regional branch office reported severe network slowness, VoIP call jitter, and web portal timeouts across all workstations during business hours. Gateway traffic monitoring showed 100% WAN circuit bandwidth saturation.
resolution: The root cause was an unthrottled backup synchronization job running on an engineering workstation during peak hours that saturated the entire 100Mbps branch office WAN uplink. The engineer identified the top talker IP using NetFlow analysis ('show ip cache flow'), applied a rate-limiting QoS traffic-shaper policy to background backup streams ('bandwidth percent 10'), and restored full network responsiveness.

short_description: SSH access failure to staging database cluster caused by security group ingress rule drift
description: Backend developers and DBA team members report connection timed out when attempting to SSH into the staging PostgreSQL database cluster and bastion host from corporate developer subnets.
resolution: The root cause was an automated security group synchronization script that accidentally stripped the corporate VPN CIDR block from the staging bastion security group ingress rules. The engineer updated the AWS security group via Terraform to re-add inbound permit rule for TCP port 22 from corporate developer subnets, validated the ingress rule state, and confirmed successful SSH authentication.

short_description: VLAN pruning configuration on 802.1Q trunk dropping branch server management traffic
description: Account managers and office staff report inability to access branch file shares or web admin portals on branch servers. Network path not found error displayed on client workstations.
resolution: The root cause was an accidental VLAN pruning configuration change on intermediate aggregation switches that removed the branch management VLAN from the 802.1Q trunk allowed list. The engineer executed 'switchport trunk allowed vlan add <vlan_id>' across the inter-switch link, verified trunk encapsulation status via 'show interfaces trunk', and restored end-to-end connectivity.

short_description: GRE tunnel down between datacenter and AWS DirectConnect due to edge transit ACL blocking IP protocol 47
description: Monitoring alerted that GRE tunnel interface connecting primary datacenter to AWS VPC transit gateway transitioned to line protocol down state, causing cloud database replication to fail over to degraded public circuits.
resolution: The root cause was a transit ACL update on the upstream border router that blocked IP protocol 47 (GRE) and ICMP keepalive packets from the AWS DirectConnect gateway IP. The engineer updated the edge ACL to permit IP protocol 47 bidirectionally between DirectConnect endpoints ('permit gre host <local_ip> host <remote_ip>'), reset the GRE tunnel interface, and verified line protocol up with sub-millisecond database replication latency.

short_description: Inter-VNI VXLAN EVPN traffic drops between application and database tier due to missing Symmetric IRB L3 VNI
description: Microservice application pods in VLAN 100 failed to connect to database clusters in VLAN 200 across leaf switches in the data center fabric, resulting in connection timeouts despite intra-VNI L2 traffic working normally.
resolution: The root cause was a missing Symmetric IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) L3 VNI route-target export configuration on the newly provisioned leaf switch pair. The engineer configured the tenant VRF with dedicated L3 VNI, imported and exported matching EVPN route-targets under BGP EVPN address-family, and verified EVPN Type-5 prefix route exchange. Inter-VNI database queries connected with 0% loss.

short_description: New hire laptop missing company apps due to missing Autopilot device security group assignment
description: New hire received a brand new corporate laptop out of the box, but upon booting, the desktop was empty with no company applications, VPN profiles, or security certificates installed.
resolution: The root cause was that the newly provisioned device had not been assigned to the Autopilot Device Security Group in Microsoft Intune, causing Autopilot application deployment to be skipped. The IT technician added the device hardware hash and serial number to the targeted dynamic device group in Microsoft Intune, initiated a remote sync, and verified automated installation of required corporate application suites.

short_description: International travel Windows logon lockout resolved by Start-Before-Logon GlobalProtect VPN
description: Senior director traveling abroad entered Windows credentials correctly but received error 'Your credentials could not be verified because your domain is not available' after offline system recovery cleared cached credentials.
resolution: The root cause was that the laptop's cached domain credentials buffer was cleared during an offline system recovery, requiring direct line-of-sight to an Active Directory Domain Controller before local Windows logon is permitted. The technician guided the user to establish a Start-Before-Logon (SBL) GlobalProtect VPN tunnel directly from the Windows lock screen network icon, connecting to the corporate Domain Controller and authenticating the user successfully.
